title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and persists in a population under social influence, policy interventions, information campaigns, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Persons observe adoption among their social neighbors and update their attitude and adoption probability accordingly.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Households influence members’ mask-wearing via shared norms and resource sharing (mask stock).

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: PublicHealthAuthority sets mandates and enforcement that affect Persons’ compliance; Locations may enforce entry rules.

interactions.name: information_campaign
interactions.description: PublicHealthAuthority and MediaChannels broadcast messages that shift risk perception, trust, and misinformation.

interactions.name: retail_purchase
interactions.description: Persons buy masks from Retailers subject to price, income, and inventory constraints.

interactions.name: public_observation
interactions.description: At Locations, Persons observe the prevalence of mask-wearing among co-present individuals, increasing or decreasing their propensity to adopt.

metrics.name: adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of persons currently wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_threshold
metrics.description: Number of days required to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum observed adoption rate over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over the final evaluation window (e.g., last 14 days).

metrics.name: compliance_rate_under_mandate
metrics.description: Adoption rate while a mandate is active, capturing policy compliance.

metrics.name: inequality_of_adoption
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across subgroups (e.g., income quintiles), such as Gini coefficient.

metrics.name: price_effect_sensitivity
metrics.description: Estimated elasticity of adoption with respect to mask price.

metrics.name: supply_shortage_days
metrics.description: Count of days when retailers’ inventories cannot meet demand.

metrics.name: churn_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which previously adopting individuals abandon mask-wearing.

metrics.name: campaign_reach
metrics.description: Average fraction of population reached by information campaigns per period.
